trigger.headline: Fear Came Back: VIX 35.89 from 19.30. Gold -9.5%, Bitcoin -13.9%, copper -9.9% and oil -5.2% all fell with stocks. Only Treasury bonds rose.

chain: the VIX nearly doubles and investors sell everything at once
trading volumes jump and bid-ask spreads widen, which is what market makers earn on
links.exposure_source: Virtu Financial 10-K FY2025, Item 1 and Item 1A: market making revenue depends on trading volumes and volatility

chain: investors sell stocks, gold and Bitcoin and buy Treasury bonds
Treasury trading volume on electronic bond platforms jumps
links.exposure_source: Tradeweb Markets 10-K FY2025, Item 1: electronic marketplaces for rates products including U.S. Treasuries, paid by volume

chain: investors sell whatever they can to raise cash
the cash lands in money-market funds, whose managers are paid on the balances
links.exposure_source: Federated Hermes 10-K FY2025, Item 1: money market assets are the majority of its managed assets

chain: the VIX closes near 36 and a record stock-market debut sinks
companies postpone share offerings and mergers, so advisory and underwriting fees slip
links.exposure_source: Evercore 10-K FY2025, Item 1: Investment Banking and Equities segment earns advisory and underwriting fees

chain: the VIX closes near 36 and a record stock-market debut sinks
the market for new listings and company sales freezes
buyout firms cannot sell holdings, so realized performance fees fall
links.exposure_source: Carlyle Group 10-K FY2025, Item 1 and Item 1A: performance allocations are realized when fund investments are sold
